$comment: HOW THIS PROJECT IS DELIVERED (delivery plan step 7, 19.11.2026: «A new project joins by declaring two things: its
class and its path-to-suite map»). Checked by scripts/check-delivery.mjs on every pull request (guards.yml).
delivery_class: 'A' client work, released on demand with full gates; 'B' a live product: staging on every merge,
production in ONE nightly train that Cockpit's release queue starts at train_at (Zurich), a pull request labelled
«hotfix» goes at once; 'C' an internal tool, released whenever its tests are green.
Where the class is kept: Cockpit's run_queue_setting.pilot (fields delivery_class, train_at, night_gates). This file
is what the project declares; joining copies these fields into its pilot entry once (node scripts/check-delivery.mjs
--pilot <owner/repo> prints the entry), and from then on Cockpit's pilot entry decides.
night: the heavy night suites Cockpit's release dispatcher starts (its night list, run_queue_night). No workflow of
this project may start a heavy suite with GitHub's schedule: it starts them hours late.
suites: THE PATH-TO-SUITE MAP. Step 4 of the delivery plan (test each change once) defines its shape. Until then it
stays null and nothing reads it.
